summary: Official English and Indonesian discovery found the Ternate municipal open-data portal, the local Kantor Pertanahan Kota Ternate, and ATR/BPN BHUMI/ATLAS. Public API and viewer checks produced no safe native parcel ID plus geometry, so no sample was retained.
queryOutcomes: Both first-party discovery queries are recorded in the city record with actual result URLs. English discovery found official municipal and ATR/BPN leads; Indonesian discovery confirmed the local land office and public Ternate data portal.
requestOutcomes: The municipal portal, its public API search/mapset routes, local ATR/BPN site, ATLAS, and BHUMI were fetched over verified HTTPS. Five bounded search terms returned zero matching parcel/cadastral results; no CRS, native parcel ID, or geometry response was exposed.
scopeLimits: Local registry/custodian evidence is official office/procedure evidence, not verified open parcel geometry coverage
No citywide or exact-point parcel inference made
National ATR/BPN sources are distinguished from the local Ternate custodian
No credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, private token, unsafe fields, or TLS-disable exception used
uncertainty: The parcel source may require authenticated access, an unindexed layer, or an office procedure not exposed by the inspected public routes. Empty search results, map extent limitations, and the lack of an exact-point hit are not evidence of citywide absence.

runtimeQualification.reason: No independently qualified real Ternate adapter or verified public parcel geometry/native-ID response.
